newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech real final Sept ind output up 6.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech real final Sept ind output up 6.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech real definitive industrial output in September grew by 6.9 percent, year-on-year, putting output for the first nine months of the year up 8.4 percent, year-on-year, the Czech Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
It added that average industrial monthly wages grew, in nominal terms, 17.0 percent in September compared with a 15.1 percent rise in August, year-on-year.
INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT SEPT/96 AUG/96 JAN-SEPT 96 SEPT/95

NOTE. Preliminary estimates in brackets. The average nominal industrial wage in September was 9,114 crowns compared with 9,307 in August. Wage results sample companies with 100 or more employees while output results include estimates of smaller firms as well.
